data.Q: Who says he will kill David?
data.A: Ishbi-Benob says he will kill David.

data.Q: What happens before Abishai rescues David?
data.A: Ishbi-Benob says he will kill David.
data.wrong_answer: David’s men vow that David must not go to battle again.

data.Q: What happens after Abishai kills the Philistine?
data.A: David’s men vow to David he must not go to battle again.
data.wrong_answer: Ishbi-Benob says he will kill David.

data.Q: Why do David’s men tell David not to go out with them again?
data.A: To keep the lamp of Israel from going out.

data.Q: To whom do David’s men make their vow?
data.A: They make their vow to David.
